description: Phase 10: Production monitoring, structured logging, performance telemetry, automated backups, non-destructive disaster recovery drills, and maintenance automation.

userStories.title: Structured Application Logging & PII Scrubbing
userStories.description: As a platform SRE, I want structured JSON application logging with automatic scrubbing of passwords, secrets, bearer tokens, and PII, so that incidents can be debugged without exposing sensitive data.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/logger.ts with log levels (INFO, WARN, ERROR, DEBUG)
Scrub sensitive fields: password, secret, token, key, authorization, cookie
Include timestamp, context tags, durationMs, and error stack traces in output
Add unit tests verifying scrubbed fields and JSON formatting
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Ensure logger does not throw on circular references or non-serializable objects.

userStories.title: SRE Monitoring & Health Diagnostics Gateway
userStories.description: As a system administrator, I want an authenticated admin monitoring API endpoint that provides real-time system metrics, memory utilization, database latency, and error rates.
acceptanceCriteria: Create GET /api/admin/monitoring endpoint restricted to SUPERADMIN role
Report Node.js memory metrics (rss, heapUsed, heapTotal, external) and process uptime
Report database latency, connection status, and table record counts
Report recent error log summary and slow request counts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Performance Latency Interceptor & SLA Anomaly Tracker
userStories.description: As a DevOps engineer, I want performance latency tracking that aggregates endpoint response percentiles (P50, P90, P99) and flags slow requests exceeding SLA thresholds (>500ms).
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/performance-monitor.ts tracking endpoint durations
Calculate statistical percentiles (P50, P90, P99) across recorded requests
Flag requests exceeding 500ms threshold as slow request warnings
Add unit tests validating percentile calculations and threshold alerting
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Keep in-memory ring buffer bounded to prevent unbounded memory growth.

userStories.title: Automated Non-Destructive Disaster Recovery Drill
userStories.description: As an SRE, I want an automated disaster recovery drill script that tests restoring database backups into an isolated test environment without touching production data.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/test-restore-drill.mjs executing non-destructive restore rehearsal
Create verified test database backup and restore into temporary isolated SQLite file
Validate database tables, foreign keys, row counts, and checksums in restored copy
Clean up temporary drill database and report RTO/RPO drill metrics
Add npm run drill script to package.json
userStories.notes: Never overwrite production dev.db during restore drill.

userStories.title: Maintenance Automation & Expired Token Cleanup
userStories.description: As a platform operator, I want an automated maintenance routine that cleans up expired tokens, optimizes database storage, and verifies secret rotation health.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/maintenance.mjs performing routine housekeeping
Prune expired password reset tokens and verification tokens older than expiration dates
Prune expired invitation tokens
Add npm run maintenance script to package.json
Report cleaned record counts and database status
userStories.notes: Perform all deletions in safe atomic operations with audit logging.

userStories.title: Production Monitoring & Maintenance Runbook Documentation
userStories.description: As an on-call engineer, I want comprehensive documentation covering alerting thresholds, disaster recovery runbooks, maintenance schedules, and incident response procedures.
acceptanceCriteria: Create docs/MONITORING_MAINTENANCE.md
Document alerting thresholds (error rate >1%, latency P99 >1000ms, DB latency >50ms)
Document RTO (<15 min) and RPO (<1 hour) recovery objectives
Document maintenance automation schedules and secret rotation procedures
userStories.notes: Include clear escalation contacts and incident severity definitions.
